purpose: Primary evidence for the four nil declarations that unblock gross/net debt in the WI-3 dataset. Every quote is verbatim from the audited consolidated financial statements of the issuer; nothing is paraphrased, estimated or taken from another issuer.

document.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024
document.publicationNote: the statements are signed and dated April 18, 2024 in the signature block of the balance sheet and the profit and loss statement; the Q4/FY24 results were announced that day
document.auditor: Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP, Chartered Accountants (Firm's Registration No. 117366W/W-100018)
document.retrievedAt: 2026-11-06T13:5xZ (fetch tool has no per-request stamp; the WI-3 retrieval followed the WI-2 interval and preceded the ingest at 2026-11-06T14:05:00.000Z)

parse.locatorNote: the PDF parser returns transport chunks, not printed page numbers, so each quote is anchored by note/section plus chunk index; the document's own index places Note 2.11 at pages 20-26 and Note 2.12 at pages 26-31

The equity shares represented by American Depositary Shares (ADS) carry similar rights to voting and dividends as the other equity shares. Each ADS represents one underlying equity share.

declarations.scopeNuance: the sentence speaks of 'the Company' (parent). It is applied to the consolidated block because consolidated owners' equity comprises only equity share capital (₹2,071 crore) and other equity (₹86,045 crore), with non-controlling interests (₹345 crore) separately presented, and no preference instrument appears in the consolidated balance sheet or in the authorised share capital (480,00,00,000 equity shares of ₹5 each only).
validation: authorised share capital lists equity shares only (₹2,400 crore)
no preference share line in the consolidated balance sheet
no dividend or liquidation preference other than the irrevocable controlled trusts' corpus noted in the same section

relatedObservations.topic: restricted cash inside the cash line
relatedObservations.quotedWording: Cash and cash equivalents as at March 31, 2024 and March 31, 2023 include restricted cash and bank balances of ₹348 crore and ₹362 crore respectively.
relatedObservations.locator: Note 2.9 CASH AND CASH EQUIVALENTS (document pages 19-20; parse chunk 9 of 17)
relatedObservations.consequence: the filed cash and cash equivalents used by the net-debt block include ₹348 crore the filing calls restricted; schema v1 cannot separate it (L-006), so net cash is overstated by that amount and the bundle states the size of the effect

declarationGrammar: each declaration enters the dataset as a `periods.csv` cell of the form `NIL: <quoted wording>` on the 2024-03-31 CONSOLIDATED row, with filing_ref INFY-INDAS-CONSOL-FY24; the ingester refuses a bare NIL (NIL_WITHOUT_QUOTED_WORDING) and a nil without a filing_ref (NIL_WITHOUT_PROVENANCE)
